stories.title: The ‘fascinating’ way Tiger Woods stunned his coach with how he prepared for Th...
stories.summary: Sean Foley has revealed that he once saw Tiger Woods preparing for The Open Championship by wearing waterproof clothing while practicing in 100 degree heat on the range in Florida.
stories.quickRead: Sean Foley said Tiger Woods prepped for The Open by practicing on a 100° Florida range wearing full waterproof rain gear to simulate the cold, wet links conditions he expected in Britain.  Foley called the routine “fascinating” because Woods tried to make Open-weather discomfort feel normal long before tournament week—an example of Tiger’s extreme, detail-obsessed preparation.

stories.summary: The PGA Tour’s revamped 2027 Korn Ferry Tour season will award 40 PGA Tour cards—double the current allotment—across a 25-tournament schedule spann...
stories.quickRead: The PGA Tour’s revamped 2027 Korn Ferry Tour season will award 40 PGA Tour cards—double the current allotment—across a 25-tournament schedule spanning seven countries and 15 states.  That expansion means far more players can play their way onto the PGA Tour through Korn Ferry performance, raising the stakes all year and reshaping how rising pros plan their path to full Tour status.

stories.summary: Butch Harmon has revealed that slow motion swings were the key to Tiger Woods working on the changes within his game after his first major win, and believes that amateur golfers should do...
stories.quickRead: Butch Harmon said Tiger Woods’ go-to move right after a lesson was to make slow-motion swings to “feel” the new positions and lock in the change before speeding up.  Harmon recommends amateurs copy it because it improves sequencing and contact, making the lesson’s fix stick instead of disappearing once you return to full-speed swings.

stories.title: Hero World Challenge field announced, but will Tiger Woods play?
stories.summary: The field for the 2026 Hero World Challenge is mostly set, although there are still spots available if the host, Tiger Woods, wants to play.
stories.quickRead: Tiger Woods is not in the 17-player field announced for the 2026 Hero World Challenge, but three sponsor-exemption spots remain open that would allow the tournament host to add himself.  Scottie Scheffler and Hideki Matsuyama headline the December event at Albany in the Bahamas, and whether Woods uses an exemption will be the biggest late decision in the final field.
